description: Local leaders from across Arizona's Sixth Congressional District come together to tout Congressman Juan Ciscomani’s record of results for the district in a new 30-second ad. title: NEW AD: Local Mayors and Leaders Highlight Ciscomani's Record of Results in Every Corner of Arizona’s Sixth District — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
